searchText: Seeing as Lido streams money to the devs <@194432762315407360> the only C++ link in the devp2p page is aleth which says its discontinued. Is there any C++ implementation of discv5? related, do you know if the wireshark dissectors linked there from Consensys cover discv5? Looking at this repo <https://github.com/ethereum/devp2p> Wireshark dissectors are very old and will not work for discv5 In fact I could never get them to work There is no C++ implementation right now thanks, I was afraid you'd say that 🙂 Seems Silkworm only have discv4, but you can reach out to them and ask the details. https://github.com/erigontech/silkworm/tree/master/silkworm/sentry/discovery/disc_v4
